name: birthday_cake_candles
description: Deadpan office birthday cake (057): tall, slightly lopsided two-tier white-iced cake with a pale blue #bfe6ff drip edge on each tier, on a plain round grey board, crowded with ~50 thin red-and-white striped lit candles (yellow #ffe24a flames with white cores, soft glow). No sprinkles, no face, no text. ANCHOR BOTTOM-CENTRE (board on y=0); ~370x420 (x -184..184, y -420..12).
